documentation.description:
Stands in for the dbt-core invocation.

        The env vars below are exactly the handoff the roadmap flags as the most
        fragile link in the chain: whatever dbt runs next must inherit this
        task's run id as its OpenLineage parent, or the pipeline splits into two
        unrelated trees.
